usage: evaluate.py [-h] --training-run TRAINING_RUN --seeds SEEDS SEEDS SEEDS
                   SEEDS SEEDS --deterministic --output OUTPUT
                   [--episode-wall-seconds EPISODE_WALL_SECONDS]

Five frozen, deterministic PPO attempts; no training and no automatic reset.
The environment owns physics, reset and success. This module records its
evidence and independently checks the bookkeeping, not a second standing
criterion.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --training-run TRAINING_RUN
  --seeds SEEDS SEEDS SEEDS SEEDS SEEDS
  --deterministic
  --output OUTPUT
  --episode-wall-seconds EPISODE_WALL_SECONDS
                        Cooperative wall watchdog per attempt, including reset
                        (default: 180).
